prompt: I own a small gym and only have about $1,000 for marketing. Using the Brick & Mortar Funnels book, how would Alex Hormozi get 100 members in 100 days? Include the numbers.
assertions: Explains client-financed acquisition (point-of-sale cash covers this customer AND the next)
Recommends high-ticket packages/challenge offers instead of a cheap commodity membership (e.g., 6-Week challenge, $99/week tiers)
Gives the ~$1,100 average cash per sale (e.g., 1 whale $2,500, 1 above average $1,200, 3 normal $600 out of 5 sales from 10 prospects)
Calculates spend per show (~$550 per show at 50% close, so ~$275 per show)
Describes the funnel: ad -> opt-in -> scheduling page -> Facebook group, and contacting all leads
Mentions the follow-on sales (food, supplements, 12-month, paid in full) and/or the $1 -> $3 reinvestment rule
